revision: v3: user confirmed fixed percentage limits on 2026-11-03; zero-cost attribution and documented-suspension audit remain unchanged.
risk_limit_interpretation: User confirmed fixed 15 percent for both monthly loss and lifetime peak drawdown; no fixed currency cap.
execution: Prior-close signals, next-open price proxy, observed opening limits, daily volume capacity cap. No intraday auction or queue reconstruction.
risk: Closing high-water mark never resets; month starts from previous close; constrained variant sizes exposure to remaining loss budget and permanently halts new buys after an actual hard breach.
corporate_actions: Implemented distributions, record-date entitlements, ex-date receivables, cash usable after payout date, bonus shares locked until listing. Unknown payment dates remain locked.
valuation: Last observed marks during documented suspension; delisting recovery stress is zero and flagged inconclusive; unexplained valuation or adjustment events prevent acceptance.
limitations: Paper capital and cost scenarios are research assumptions pending user-specific settings.
Scenario costs and cash-dividend haircut do not reconstruct historical statutory taxes, broker minimum fees or all corporate actions.
Daily-bar opening fills and daily-volume caps are proxies, not verified auction fills.
The adverse-shock sizing rule cannot guarantee losses stay below limits after gaps or blocked exits.
2024 onward remains unused in this study.
